title: Desktop frontend iOS-inspired refinement

include: Refine the existing six-screen Desktop frontend with iOS-inspired system color, grouped surfaces, and control treatments
Remove the brand title from the left sidebar while retaining product identity in the native title bar and workspace header
Add a corresponding accessible SVG icon to each of the six navigation destinations
Preserve fixture-backed interactions, explicit simulated/unavailable states, responsive behavior, and keyboard accessibility
Frontend verification, independent review, and dedicated pull request
exclude: Gateway runtime, backend APIs, IPC server, and real upstream calls
Credential persistence, production authentication, and database changes

acceptance: Development startup and production build succeed
All six screens are navigable, each navigation item has its SVG icon, and the sidebar has no site title
Semantic system colors, protocol distinctions, and grouped controls are applied consistently
Fixture data and simulated outcomes are not represented as live runtime evidence
Responsive and keyboard accessibility checks are recorded
Independent review is completed and findings are addressed or reported
rollback: Revert the dedicated frontend PR; no persistent data or runtime side effects are introduced.
